# Home Environment Manager v0.6.0b107 — clear, consistent room overview readings

Built directly on v0.6.0b106, preserving its on/off heating maximum and cooling minimum setpoint correction.

- Separate each collapsed room reading into a compact cell with a subtle border, consistent padding and clear spacing.
- Give temperature, humidity, Mold, Lux and air-quality readings the same numeric font size, weight, icon size and cell height. Native source buttons and plain readings share the same styling; clickable metrics no longer inherit a larger button font.
- Keep each metric's label, value, unit and average marker together. Preserve physical activity colors, native entity links and contributor-bound average trend dialogs.
- Adapt the room overview to its actual Lovelace column width as well as mobile screens. Keep single-row summaries, a maximum of four readings and the existing reduction of secondary readings at narrow widths, without horizontal scrollbars.

The browser regression mixes clickable temperature/humidity averages, a plain Mold reading and native Lux/PM2.5 readings. It checks computed sizes, actual icon geometry, cell spacing, clipping, overflow and source/average interactions at 320–800px and narrow desktop columns. All inherited backend and browser release checks run before publication.

Update to **v0.6.0b107** in HACS prereleases, restart Home Assistant, and refresh the dashboard to load the updated card JavaScript.
